text:
The engineer’s deposition is inadmissible as hearsay not within any recognized exception. Former testimony does not apply: the company examined him, but it lacked a similar motive in the wrongful-termination case to develop the structural-defect issue now offered in the products case, and the statement is neither a party-opponent admission nor against his own interest. Exclusion does not rest on a lack of opportunity to examine him.

CONFIDENCE: 84
